name: Dropdown menu
description: A button that opens a list of actions, grouped and separated.

props.name: label
props.description: Trigger text, and its accessible name when icon replaces it.

props.name: icon
props.description: Shows an icon-only trigger instead of the text.

props.name: groups
props.type: { label?: string; items: { label: string; icon?: ReactNode; shortcut?: string; danger?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onSelect?: () => void }[] }[]
props.description: Groups of items, separated by hairlines.

props.name: align
props.description: Aligns the menu to the trigger's start or end edge. Default start.

a11y: Menu button pattern: aria-haspopup, aria-expanded and aria-controls on the trigger; role="menu" and menuitem.
Arrow keys, Home and End move between items; Escape closes and returns focus; Tab and outside clicks close it.
